prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: proposed replacement sign-face artwork / approval mockup for the Arcane Emporium magic shop in Stone & Shadow. Square, straight-on flat painted sign face, not a photograph or perspective street scene.
Input image: the existing provisioner sign is the EDIT TARGET and material/style reference. Preserve its exact square wooden plaque silhouette, worn reddish-brown edge planks, chipped pale-gold painted border, little iron nail heads, hand-painted grain and subtly pixelated game texture. It must still belong beside the existing town's inn and smithy signs.
Primary request: change the central provisioner design into an unmistakable MAGIC SHOP emblem. Completely remove the bread loaf, wheat stalks and tied food sack. Repaint the central inner wooden field in worn DEEP INDIGO blue, allowing a little grain and wear to show. Center ONE large round-bellied, narrow-necked corked potion flask containing bright teal/turquoise liquid, with a pale gold outline and a small readable highlight; the flask should occupy most of the middle. Behind and slightly to the left of the flask, show ONE broad cream parchment spell scroll, unrolled vertically with curled ends and a few SIMPLE non-letter decorative marks, its silhouette plainly identifiable. Above the flask neck at upper right, add ONE small crisp eight-point gold magical star. This is a clear painted heraldic shop symbol: potion + scroll + star. Simple large shapes that remain readable when reduced to a small in-game hanging sign.
Composition and finish: front-facing square sign artwork filling the whole image with the same outer margins as the input. Balanced emblem, rich but restrained teal, cream and gold on indigo; warm weathered wooden border, aged paint and gentle dimensional brush shading. Paint the symbols onto the wood, not real objects fastened to it. Match the original illustrated pixel-textured artwork, with crisp clean silhouettes and no tiny busy details.
Constraints: only change central emblem and inner paint color; keep the board shape, border, wear and material character. Opaque background. No text, letters, numerals, runic writing, logo, watermark, hands, people, storefront, hanging chains or new mounting bracket. No bread, wheat, food sack or other provisioner symbol anywhere. No neon bloom, hovering particles, photorealistic glass, glossy 3D render or modern vector-flat icon. This is a concept mockup to approve before updating any live game asset.
